item.title: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions
item.description: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions, a new serverless compute primitive where your code handles HTTP requests directly. Your code listens on a port and handles requests as it would on any HTTP server. (4 sources: aws, javascriptweekly, nodeweekly, rprogramming)

item.title: Node.js v24.22.0 (LTS)
item.description: Node.js® is a free, open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment that lets developers create servers, web apps, command line tools and scripts. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Zod 4 Got Rid of a Bunch of CPUs for Us
item.description: We upgraded to Zod 4 and worker CPU dropped by nearly a third. One hot path does about 98 million parses a day. We're now Zod's first Platinum Sponsor. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Fast Node.js is Mostly About Doing Less
The Disappointing Death of Deno
item.description: A breakdown of the history of Deno, the emergence of Bun, and a reaction to the Cloudflare acquisition by a developer who went all-in on Deno years ago. (1 source: nodeweekly)
